title: Web Development
summary: Building responsive and dynamic websites using the latest technologies.
description: From personal portfolios to large-scale applications, I build clean and high-performing web experiences.
author: Saad Lraba

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: Web development involves building fast, scalable, and responsive websites. Using technologies like React for the frontend and Laravel for the backend, I create seamless user experiences.

sections.heading: Process
sections.content: I start with gathering requirements, designing wireframes, developing frontend and backend, testing, and finally deploying to production.

sections.heading: Technologies Used
sections.content: React, Laravel, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs, Git, Vercel.

highlights: Frontend with React, backend with Laravel
Full-stack delivery from design to deployment
